milestones.outcome: The live-checkout defect is recorded as evidence and a schema-true legacy machine fixture exists for later migration tests.
exit_criteria: The closeout card carries the real pre-implementation revision.
A baseline test proves the current parsers accept the legacy fixture bytes and that a legacy install links into the clone.
milestones.boundary: Evidence and fixtures only; no product behavior changes.

milestones.outcome: A machine bootstraps from one tap and every test fixture starts that way.
exit_criteria: tap add on an empty MASK_HOME followed by install deploys a v2 consumer from the store with no checkout on disk.
The full suite passes on the tap-first fixtures while legacy code still exists.
milestones.boundary: Config v3 accepted, init without --source, tap-add bootstrap, fixture cutover; no legacy deletion yet.

milestones.outcome: The live-checkout engine is gone and update fetches every referenced tap.
exit_criteria: No link producer can target a Git checkout except source dev-link.
Retired commands are absent from capabilities and exit 2; legacy configuration exits 4 migration.required.
update fetches each tap once, isolates failed taps and applies one journal.
milestones.boundary: Engine retirement and the new update module; docs and migration follow.

milestones.outcome: doctor detects and migrates v1 and v2 machines, projects and personal scopes with recovery.
exit_criteria: The fixture crash matrix recovers with rollback or complete at every checkpoint.
A machine with an empty registry migrates its configuration only.
milestones.boundary: Detection, mapping, journal and refusals from contracts/MIGRATION.md; no real machine is migrated here.

milestones.outcome: Help, documentation and capabilities describe only the tap model.
exit_criteria: README recipes replay verbatim through the public CLI.
milestones.boundary: Presentation and documents; no engine changes.

milestones.outcome: The real AgentSkills package and the owner's machine are exercised natively through taps.
exit_criteria: The qualifier passes on native Windows 11 and macOS including push-then-update and the legacy lab.
The owner's v1 machine is migrated by doctor with the transcript recorded and the clone untouched.
milestones.boundary: Evidence gathering; defects return to their owning cards.

milestones.outcome: RFC-MASK-0020 is closed with direct evidence for every criterion.
exit_criteria: Every acceptance row names a real command or observation, outcome and revision.
The structure gate reports zero violations and the full suite passes on both platforms.
